interpretation: 22/24 counts the number of technical Gaia positions with any parseable original IRSA ZTF positional source tables over past runs, not 22 physical matches or good light curves.
Both remaining failures are archive technical outcomes, not evidence that a physical star is absent or non-variable.
The 24-source original Gaia RUWE/neighbor source-derived flags are existing original Actions evidence, not an independent new source query.
Original SIMBAD FT Tau ↔ Gaia DR3 149623711269425408 exact catalogue name alias is not a per-epoch physical Gaia–ZTF identification.
Original v2.0 16 masked-image PSF source fits and later FT Tau six-image follow-ups are separate research denominators and are not summed as unique stars.

This is a COMPLETE R2 24-source screening adjudication yielding a scientifically defensible NO-GO for positive physical ID and R3 physical variability inference, NOT a claim of scientifically authenticated source identities.
No new real original archive observations, source fluxes, raw FITS pixels or private unpublished ALMA data were used or committed here.

The original publisher IOP/AJ Luhman 2023 201,726-byte machine-readable adopted-member Table 2 was downloaded live from the publisher, SHA-256 recorded, and all 24 exact Gaia IDs and positions compared successfully; this replaces the older secondary-mirror-only source provenance caveat.

The original official Table 2 is the AUTHOR'S adopted-member catalogue. Its provenance has been checked, but it does not independently re-evaluate each source as a physically secure Taurus association, and does not prove ZTF source identity.
